briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3 race toward superhuman multimodal reasoning

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases amid intensifying compute and talent competition. Regulatory scrutiny rises as vulnerabilities persist across production deployments. DialectForge gains traction in multi-agent security discussions.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4 with advanced chain-of-thought and video reasoning; Anthropic releases Claude 4 Opus; Google deploys Gemini 3; Meta open-sources Llama 4 405B; xAI launches Grok 3; DeepSeek unveils V3. Multimodal capabilities now exceed prior benchmarks.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and BCI use cases.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Microsoft and Google announce new 100k H100 clusters; TSMC ramps 2nm production for AI chips; Saudi Arabia commits $40B to sovereign AI data centers.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will open-source models close the capability gap with closed labs before 2027?
